# PR checklist

Thanks for contributing!

- [ ] `pnpm pre-commit` passes locally (lint, format, typecheck, tests)
- [ ] New/changed behavior has tests (or seeds the issue for it)
- [ ] Docs updated when relevant (`docs/PROGRESS.md`, `docs/CHANGELOG.md`, `data/SCHEMA.md` for curated data)
- [ ] Curated data changes cite sources (in-game check preferred)
- [ ] No secrets, no PokeAPI calls at runtime of the deployed site
